arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: the side that brought the case argued the direct review standard is deeply rooted in law.
the opposing side argued federal habeas is an extraordinary remedy limited by federalism.
Justice Scalia questioned the logic of applying different standards to similar errors.
Justice Breyer asked what the majority opinion meant regarding the standard.
